Option_Name: Retained 1D SSA Flowlines with Enhanced Empirical Lateral Drag
Governing_Equations: 1D SSA: d/dx(4 H nu du/dx) - beta_b u - (2H/W) tau_lat = rho_i g H ds/dx
Stress_Balance_Assumptions: Centerline longitudinal stretching and basal/lateral resistance; zero transverse stress gradient
Lateral_Drag_Representation: Parameterized body force: tau_lat = (u / (mu B W))^(1/n) with empirical shape factor kappa_shape
Tributary_Flow_Treatment: Ignored or added as uncoupled 1D scalar mass source term S_trib(x); zero momentum exchange
Grounding_Line_Dynamics: 1D sub-grid moving boundary using Schoof or kinematic flux Q_GL = H W u
Moving_Geometry_and_Continuity: 1D Finite-Volume continuity: dH/dt + d(uH)/dx = SMB along 1D line
Ice_Shelf_Buttressing_Coupling: Scalar back-stress parameter theta_buttress applied at downstream calving face
Surface_Mass_Balance_Coupling: 1D along-flowline accumulation profile from RACMO / elevation lapse rate
Computational_Requirements: Negligible (< 1 s per 5-yr simulation on single CPU thread)
Domain_A_Grounded_Footprint_Coverage: Partial (50-60% via discrete flowlines; requires 40-50% unmodeled remainder)
Software_Engineering_and_Reproducibility: Extremely simple; existing codebase; high reproducibility but low physical validity
Principal_Scientific_Limitations: Fails in narrow fjords where lateral shear margins dominate (Flask -49%, Millett +1100%); leaves half of Domain A unmodeled
Overall_Feasibility_Verdict: REJECTED (Structurally inadequate to resolve 2D fjord physics and regional mass balance)

Stress_Balance_Assumptions: 1D longitudinal stress along branches; normal stress / flux conservation enforced at junction nodes
Lateral_Drag_Representation: Parameterized lateral body force on each individual branch
Tributary_Flow_Treatment: Explicit 1D branch convergence: sum(Q_in) = Q_out at nodes; momentum jump condition across junctions
Grounding_Line_Dynamics: 1D GL migration on the main outlet trunk
Moving_Geometry_and_Continuity: Branch-wise 1D FV continuity with nodal boundary flux balancing
Basal_Traction_Representation: Branch-specific scalar C_bed_k for each tributary and trunk
Ice_Shelf_Buttressing_Coupling: Shelf buttressing applied at terminal trunk calving front
Surface_Mass_Balance_Coupling: Branch-specific accumulation profiles integrated over tributary sub-catchments
Computational_Requirements: Low (< 5 s per simulation on CPU)
Domain_A_Grounded_Footprint_Coverage: Partial-to-Moderate (65-75% coverage; still leaves slow interior divides unmodeled)
Software_Engineering_and_Reproducibility: High code complexity (graph traversal, moving branch nodes); brittle topology when flow divides shift
Principal_Scientific_Limitations: Still relies on parameterized 1D lateral drag; fails under dynamic thinning where ice divides migrate; cannot resolve curved 2D grounding lines
Overall_Feasibility_Verdict: REJECTED (Excessive architectural complexity without eliminating 1D physical approximations)
